subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: The real story behind Smart Notes' meeting summary feature—and why it exists
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM, and I was staring at a blank screen, exhausted from a 12-hour day of back-to-back calls. I had just finished a meeting where we decided something huge—but by the time I hung up, I couldn't remember the key action item. I scribbled notes on a napkin, then lost the napkin. That was the moment I thought: 'This is insane. There has to be a better way.'

I spent the next three nights coding the first version of what became Smart Notes' instant summary feature. I didn't care about polish or perfection—I just wanted a tool that would capture every decision, every follow-up, and every deadline without me having to think twice. The first prototype was ugly, but it worked: it turned chaotic conversations into structured clarity. And that feeling—of walking away from a meeting with zero mental clutter—is exactly what I wanted for everyone else.

That's why the one-tap recording and AI summary features exist. When you open the app and hit that record button, you're not just transcribing words—you're getting the same clarity I craved at 2AM. It's built to save you from the napkin-scratching, the frantic searching, and the 'I'll remember later' traps. Every time you use it, you're using the feature I needed most.

Open Smart Notes today and try recording your next meeting or lecture. Just one tap, and you'll see why I stayed up to build this. P.S. The first summary you create locks in your week's clarity—users who start on day one report feeling 80% less chaos after calls.
